author.scope: Test harness, execution and criterion mapping

design.state: accepted for Unit C; implementation and testing not assessed

final_execution.source_assertions: Before and after tests: HEAD equals reviewed commit, HEAD^ equals accepted base, git write-tree equals reviewed tree, no tracked/untracked source changes, all four source hashes match; GOCACHEPROG empty. Rebuild also followed by identity checks.

criteria.criterion: A trusted native backward deletion does not append a stale final newline.
criteria.evidence: Final complete-browser exit0, nine native cases; each asserts trusted deleteContentBackward and exact saved text in two independent clients. Causal development controls reproduce five native failures on exact main.

criteria.criterion: Keyboard Backspace, retained legitimate line breaks, empty lines and Unicode remain correct.
criteria.evidence: All nine keyboard controls and all nine corresponding native cases pass. Last/middle/empty-first/empty-final/empty-middle/retained-final-newline/character-end/character-within/Unicode cases are permanent source assertions.

criteria.criterion: The repair preserves the existing complete collaboration browser contract.
criteria.evidence: Final full TestBrowserCollaboration PASS covers independent clients, concurrency, cursors, composition/emoji, local undo, persistence, reconnect, preview/Edit/View, mobile viewport, read-only behavior and live updates. The existing public-reader presence assertion follows rule10 and checks rendered-list emptiness.

criteria.criterion: The committed generated bundle is produced by the locked source inputs.
criteria.evidence: Final npm ci and npm run build exit0; all tracked source bytes remain unchanged, reviewed full tree is identical, and TestBuildInputs exits0.

criteria.criterion: Affected library, runtime, web and documentation checks pass.
criteria.evidence: Retain the exact-tree development outcomes, accepted by the implementation reviewer: npm test, affected Go vet, six docs/runtime CI shards, docs-audit and docs-verify all exit0. There has been no source delta.

criteria.criterion: Publication is tied to the accepted source and authorization.
criteria.evidence: Candidate has one parent and four changed paths; no force/amend/merge/auto-merge. Live refs and commit identities will be checked again immediately before the authorized PR publication.

earlier_attempt.results: Locked install, rebuild, build-input test and full browser passed. The whitespace comparison exited128 because shallow checkout omitted the parent object.
earlier_attempt.disposition: Harness-only correction: fetch two commits and verify HEAD^ before testing. The second complete final run passed. Product and test source did not change. Retain this failed attempt as evidence; do not report it as a passing run.

limitations: Only Unit C is in this snapshot. Unit B's independent work and its unresolved product-specification conflict are separate.
The native DOM path is exercised in Chromium, not physical mobile OS keyboard hardware.
Full-browser access headers and cookies belong to the existing repository test host; this test establishes editor behavior, not a production human-approval boundary.
No merging or auto-merge is authorized.
